verdict.rationale: Brex's expense management docs mention reimbursements being filed automatically and receipt upload/matching via the Expenses API, implying some reimbursement workflow exists, but there is no evidence detailing direct deposit reimbursement, payout timing, or end-to-end status tracking from submission to payout. Missing for 10: explicit direct-deposit reimbursement mechanism, payout SLA/timeline, and submission-to-payout tracking UI/API.
